title: Delete a DM (Apagar conversa)
summary: In a DM, Apagar conversa replaces leaving the room (ADR 0141, bipe-chat/bipe#464). The person stays in the room; a marker in account data hides the chat and every message up to now on all their devices. The other person keeps the chat. A new message brings the chat back, starting after the marker.

phase.description: deleting: the account data write runs.

marker.description: The cleared timestamp of this room in ms, from the cleared-chats account data event. Absent when never cleared.

ask.effect: From the chat list (swipe or long press) or the DM info: opens the confirm.

confirm.effect: Reads the cleared-chats account data event, merges this room with ts = the origin server time of the newest event in the room (now when there is none), keeps every other entry, writes it with Client.setAccountData. Then closes the chat; on failure shows bipe_dm_delete_error.

applyToList.effect: chat-list hides a DM while its newest event time is at or below its marker.

applyToTimeline.effect: chat-timeline drops every event at or below the marker and stops back-pagination there; search drops them too.

notes: Event type, content shape and merge rule: registries/cleared-chats.json (generated constant clearedChatsEventType), reference clearedChat* in tools/lib/registries.mjs, cases test-vectors/cleared-chats.json. A malformed entry counts as not cleared; a newer marker never moves back.
Only for a DM (Room.isDirect). A group shows group-leave.
The marker hides history on the person's devices only. It deletes nothing on the server and nothing for the other person; bipe_dm_delete_body says so.
Bipe logic: ClearedChats.marker, isHidden, keepsEvent and json(clearing:) (iOS); ClearedChats, BipeClearedChats.clear, BipeClearedTimeline.filter (Android). Move them; do not write a new merge.
